title: Social Satire in Action
grammar: Satirical stance: combining modal particles with conditional forms
goal: I can combine conditional verb forms with modal particles (szinte, mintha) to satirize absurd behavior.
I can formulate humorous critique without aggressive confrontation.
I can recognize the satirical techniques used by Hungarian feuilleton writers.
